Select the first 1000 activity rows for human single-protein target CHEMBL1275221 (Protein arginine N-methyltransferase 6). Filter for IC50 activities with exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to enforce the target filter. Join activities to compound_records and molecule_dictionary to obtain molecule identifiers. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate rows.
